units.source_text: 有人说道：“承蒙诸位夫人送来这许多华丽的奖品，美意诚可感谢！

en.t: Someone said, "We are truly grateful that the ladies have sent so many splendid prizes out of such kindness!

units.source_text: 单教百步穿柳叶的能手欣然享受，未免太杀风景了。

en.t: But it would be rather dull if only the masters who can pierce a willow leaf from a hundred paces away were allowed to enjoy them.

units.source_text: 本领差些的人应该也都来参与竞赛。”

en.t: Those whose skills are somewhat poorer should also come and take part in the contest."

units.source_text: 于是大将及以下的人都走下庭中去。

en.t: So the General and all those below him went down into the garden.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督神情特异，只管耽于沉思。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, looked strangely different and was lost entirely in brooding thought.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将约略知道他的心事，看了他那异乎寻常的气色，

en.t: General Yugiri had some idea of what was on his mind, and when he saw his unusually troubled expression,

units.source_text: 深恐做出怪事来，连自己也忧心忡忡了。

en.t: he feared deeply that Kashiwagi might do something strange, and even he himself became filled with anxiety.
He and Kashiwagi were very close.

units.source_text: 在诸亲戚之中，这两人特别心心相印，恳切关怀。

en.t: Among all their relatives, these two were especially attuned to one another and cared for each other with real concern.

units.source_text: 所以柏木略有失意，或者心中有所忧虑，夕雾便真心地寄与同情。

en.t: Therefore, whenever Kashiwagi was even a little disappointed or had some worry in his heart, Yugiri sincerely felt sympathy for him.

units.source_text: 柏木自己觉得：每逢看见了源氏，必然心中恐怖，眼睛抬不起来。

en.t: Kashiwagi himself felt that whenever he saw Genji, terror inevitably rose in his heart and he could not lift his eyes.

units.source_text: 他想：“我岂敢怀有不良之心！

en.t: He thought, "How could I dare harbor any improper feeling!

units.source_text: 即使区区小事，凡可受人指责的胡乱行为，我都不敢做，

en.t: Even in the smallest matter, I would never dare do anything reckless that others might condemn,
much less such an absurd thing as this!"

units.source_text: 他懊恼之极，又想：“那只小猫总得让我捉了去。

en.t: In the depths of his anguish, he thought again, "Somehow I must catch that kitten and take it away.

units.source_text: 虽然不能和它谈心，也可慰我孤眠之苦。”

en.t: Though I cannot confide my heart to it, it could still comfort the pain of sleeping alone."
He then set about trying to steal the kitten almost like a madman.

units.source_text: 然而这件事也很不容易办到。

en.t: Yet this too was not at all easy to accomplish.
